package.name: ai_vision_ros2_nanoowl_demo
package.description: NanoOWL (OWL-ViT) open-vocabulary detection demo for the SO-101, targeting the NVIDIA Jetson. The "swap the model, get a different demo" sibling of so101_depth_demo / so101_yolo_demo: same camera input and same /safety/protective_stop contract (ROI overlap + hysteresis), but instead of depth or a fixed COCO class set it detects whatever TEXT PROMPT you give it (default "a hand"). Runs on the Jetson GPU via a TensorRT image-encoder engine (torch2trt), with a pure-torch fallback if the engine is unavailable. Packaged as the NVIDIA variant of the ai-vision-ros2 snap on the latest/nvidia/edge channel; see docs/ai_vision_ros2_nvidia.md.
